status.en: 10 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 17% fewer than the week before, most of them in Juba, Rumbek and Abyei.
status.nb: 10 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 17 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Juba, Rumbek og Abyei.

summary.en: Coordinated cattle raids in Warrup state killed at least 72 people. A drone strike hit a market in the disputed Abyei region, killing at least 73. Fighting continues in Upper Nile where the Chollo King was airlifted to Juba and the Upper Nile Deputy Governor visited Baliet County after the deadly Adong attack, while Machar disputes Bol Mel’s claims over the Nasir attack. The UN commission warned that the peace deal is being dismantled and 2 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Koordinerte kvegraid i Warrup-stat drepte minst 72 personer. Et droneangrep rammet et marked i den omstridte Abyei-regionen, og drepte minst 73. Kampene fortsetter i Upper Nile hvor Chollo-kongen ble lufttransportert til Juba, og visepresidenten i Upper Nile besøkte Baliet fylke etter det dødelige Adong-angrepet, mens Machar bestrider Bol Mels påstander om Nasir-angrepet. FN-kommisjonen advarte om at fredsavtalen blir demontert, og to dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: South Sudanese Civil War
background.extract: The South Sudanese Civil War was a multi-sided civil war in South Sudan fought from 2013 to 2018 between government and opposition forces. The civil war caused rampant human rights abuses, including forced displacement, ethnic massacres, and killings of journalists by various parties. Since the war's end, South Sudan has been governed by a coalition formed by leaders of the former warring factions, Salva Kiir Mayardit and Riek Machar. The country continues to recover from the war while experiencing ongoing and systemic ethnic violence.
